number: 第二百四十八条の四の三十六
heading_en: System for Calculating the CVA Risk Equivalent Amount
summary_ja: SA―CVA採用最終指定親会社は、CVAリスク相当額を月ごとに算出する体制を整備する。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA establishes a system for calculating the CVA risk equivalent amount monthly.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall establish a system for calculating the CVA risk equivalent amount every month under the provisions of the preceding Subsection.
